items.quote: but if not, then let fire come out of the thornbush and consume the cedars of Lebanon!
items.contrast: Refusing the thornbush as king leads to destructive fire, whereas accepting it leads the trees to take refuge in its shade.
items.reason: The conditional explicitly states that if the trees do not accept the thornbush, fire will come from it and consume the cedars. The reader must distinguish the consequence of refusal from the result of acceptance.
